title: Full dynamic response-space coupling comparison under STANDARD DBD and NOUR
question: On the frozen real-FGC44 G11/G17 stress, does disabling MODFLOW nonlinear under-relaxation from solver initialization remove the G21 full-path trajectory falsification when the complete dynamic G16/E3 response-space P4 loop is rerun, and what are the resulting live MODFLOW and SWAP diagnostic costs relative to the standard DBD configuration?

STANDARD_DBD.role: positive-control dynamic path; expected to retain the already-falsified G21 outer-2 trajectory deviation

standard_positive_control.required_interpretation: STANDARD must continue to exhibit an outer-2 deviation >1e-12 m; G22 must not relabel the original G21 falsification.

execution_contract: Run STANDARD and NOUR in separate processes so SWAP/FMR and MODFLOW mutable state cannot leak between solver configurations.
For each configuration initialize the same real FGC44 carrier and one G16 immutable-origin diagnostic session.
Open exactly one live MODFLOW6 prepared timestep/solve and keep XOLD bitwise fixed throughout the entire dynamic coupling loop.
At every accepted outer head reevaluate the unchanged G09D/G13 E3 physical tangent through G16.
For each P4 response attempt use lambda=2^-k and qref=G(h_current)+lambda*r_current with the current physical E3 slope, exactly as G21.
Settle each affine response only through repeated admitted publish_and_solve_iteration calls in the same prepared solve; do not write or reset X, XOLD or solver-history arrays.
Accept a response attempt only with participant status 0 and the unchanged G17 merit test.
Do not use G17 head equality as an acceptance rule. Record the actual accepted trajectory for both configurations.
Stop only when the unchanged coupling flux tolerance is met after an accepted response update, or when the frozen outer/backtrack budget is exhausted.
After convergence finalize_solve exactly once and do not finalize_time_step.
Close G16 without acquiring publication authority; no ordinary FMR publication-path trial is allowed.
gates: STANDARD reports NONMETH=3 and NOUR reports NONMETH=0.
Both configurations use one prepare_time_step and one prepare_solve, keep XOLD fixed, finalize_solve at most once after convergence, and never finalize_time_step.
No direct MODFLOW state mutation or restart/reopen occurs.
STANDARD outer 1 remains within 1e-12 m of G17 and STANDARD outer 2 remains more than 1e-12 m from G17 while remaining status-0/merit-accepted, reproducing the qualitative G21 positive control.
NOUR converges under the unchanged E3/P4 status+merit and flux-residual criteria.
For NOUR, each of the three accepted heads is within 1e-12 m of the corresponding frozen G17 head.
NOUR local contractions equal [2,0,0], response status topology equals [6,6,0,0,0], and total contractions equal 2.
NOUR final head is within 1e-12 m of G17 and |final residual| <=1e-15 m/s.
Report total MODFLOW solve calls, accepted outer updates, G16 logical requests, physical participant trials and cache hits for both configurations.
Diagnostic SWAP/FMR accepted revision/time and committed ledger authority remain unchanged.
No production runtime, adapter, IMS default or HCOF/RHS code changes.

interpretation_rules.nour_recovers_full_g17_path: All NOUR trajectory/topology/final gates pass while the STANDARD positive-control outer-2 deviation remains >1e-12 m.
interpretation_rules.nour_converges_but_not_g17_equivalent: NOUR reaches the physical coupling residual gate but one or more frozen G17 trajectory/topology gates fail.
interpretation_rules.nour_not_robust_in_frozen_case: NOUR fails E3 availability, safeguard acceptance, MODFLOW convergence or outer/backtrack budget before satisfying the coupling residual.
interpretation_rules.standard_control_not_reproduced: The STANDARD arm no longer reproduces the known G21 qualitative outer-2 path deviation; causal comparison is not authoritative.

pass_interpretation: PASS yields one of the preregistered research classifications. NOUR_RECOVERS_FULL_G17_PATH would qualify a solver-configuration explanation/bridge only for this frozen carrier. It would not production-admit NOUR, E3/P4, response-space globalization or any HCOF/RHS policy.
fail_interpretation: Preserve failure. Do not change the 1e-12 trajectory gate, 1e-15 residual gate, E3 scales, P4 merit rule, lambda sequence, solver tolerances or G17 reference after seeing results.
forbidden_mutation: MODFLOW X/XOLD/solver-history state via XMI/BMI pointers

supersession.reason: G21E was preregistered first and covers the same full dynamic STANDARD-DBD versus NOUR comparison, with a more explicit separation of physical endpoint correctness, strict trajectory fidelity and cost.
supersession.gate_transfer: NONE; G21E retains its own prospectively frozen gates.
